Heard Mr.D.Selvam, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.P.Muthukumar, learned State Government Pleader for respondents 1 to 7.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the respondents have encroached upon the land of the petitioner and are trying to construct a public health centre in the petitioner's land.

Learned counsel further submits that an application has been given for measurement of the property of the petitioner along with necessary fees, but the respondent authorities are not measuring the land.
3. In case the petitioner has filed an application for measurement, complete in all respects, along with necessary fees, then it is the bounden duty of the authorities to measure the land.
